name: SessionController

test_list.description: The first send from the welcome screen issues Open{resume: None} then Submit{text}, switches to the session screen and marks the submit pending.
An empty or whitespace-only draft issues no request and stays on the current screen.
While a submit awaits Committed/Rejected, another submit issues nothing and sets a notice; the draft is kept.
Committed commits the prepared composer submission: draft becomes empty, pending false.
Rejected(reason) cancels the prepared submission: draft unchanged, pending false, notice shows the reason.
Message{kind: UserInput or Directive, text} events append user entries in order; the view's capacity errors become a notice, not a panic.
Opened clears the previous conversation, records title/workspace/branch and adds exactly one local system entry stating that model execution is unavailable.
Sessions are grouped by workspace folder (group order by newest session), rows newest first; the open session row is active.
Updated times render as 'now', 'Nm', 'Nh', 'Nd' relative to the supplied clock; future or missing times render 'now'.
A non-blank query issues Search{query}; a blank query issues nothing and clears hits.
New session with an open session issues Close, clears the conversation and returns to the welcome screen; without one it only returns.
Opening a listed session issues Open{resume: Some(id)} and switches to the session screen; opening the already-open session issues nothing.
Failed(reason) (e.g. store in use by another process) shows the reason, ends the starting state and cancels a pending submit keeping the draft.

inputs.name: event
inputs.description: Events from the desktop bridge (session opened, committed records, rejections, listings).

inputs.name: draft
inputs.description: Composer text mirrored from the UI.

output_type: Vec<BackendRequest> + view snapshots (entries, groups, notice, flags)
output_description: Requests to send to the bridge and the state the Slint window shows.
